**If + Past Simple, would + V**\n*If I *:
**If + Past Simple, would + V**
*If I **had** a car, I **would drive** to work.*

- *would* has a short form: *I'd, you'd* · negative — *wouldn't*
- instead of *would* you can use **could** (would be able to) or **might** (maybe would): *If I had more time, I **could** learn to dance.*
- *be* after *if* — **were** for all persons: *If I **were** you… · If it **were** cheaper…* (in speech people sometimes say *was*, but *If I were you* is a fixed phrase)
- question: ***What would** you **do** if…?*
- the two parts can swap places; use a comma when *if* comes first.
We ___ (go) out more if we didn't have a: We ___ (go) out more if we didn't have a baby. (2 words)
What would you do if…? — уявна ситуація: What would you do if…? — an imagined situation for conversation.
could — what I would be able to do.
would + V у головній частині; if you wer: would + V in the main part; if you were me — “in my position”.
«На твоєму місці я б…» — найуживаніша фр: “If I were you, I'd…” — the most common phrase of this type.
Ввічлива відмова: заважає умова, якої не: A polite refusal: a condition that can't be changed gets in the way.
The main part of type 2 — would + V.
Другий тип умовних речень — для уявного:: The second conditional is for imagined things: what is not true now or is unlikely to happen. The past form after *if* is not about the past here — it's a signal that “this is not real”.
Зараз умова не виконується — уявляємо ін: The condition is not true now — we imagine it differently.
Малоймовірне: виграш у лотерею, інше жит: Unlikely: winning the lottery, a different life.
На твоєму місці я б не купував цю машину: In your position, I wouldn't buy this car.
На твоєму місці я б поговорив з керівник: In your position, I'd talk to my manager.
The result of an imagined condition — would + V.
Нереальна умова → If + Past Simple: If I: An unreal condition → If + Past Simple: If I had a car…
Нереальне теперішнє: If + Past Simple, c: Unreal present: If + Past Simple, could/would + V.
Питання в 2 типі: What would you do if +: A question in type 2: What would you do if + Past Simple?
Порада «на твоєму місці» — уявна ситуаці: Advice “in your position” is an imagined situation, so were and would.
Після Past Simple в if-частині — would,: After the Past Simple in the if-part — would, not will.
Після if — Past Simple; would лише в інш: After if — Past Simple; would only in the other part.
Умова 2 типу: If + Past Simple, заперече: Type 2 condition: If + Past Simple, negative — didn't + V.
There is no time — it's just imagination.

Що б ти робив, якби загубив паспорт?: Imagine you lost your passport — what would you do?
